name: makarasty-tools
description: Thirteen everyday commands: commit and ship under your own name, review a diff with evidence, hand a chat off before its context runs out, collect bugs until a codeword, explain plainly, strip assistant tics from text, an antislop filter for UI work, phrase a vendor call in simple English, get a phone message when a chat finishes, tune the machine for a game, find what is worth updating and clean up what nobody uses. In-engine hooks suggest a handoff past 700k tokens of context, run plain-execution subagents on Sonnet, refuse git commands that throw away uncommitted work or skip hooks, recursive deletes of the project, home, a drive or .git, a second whole-suite test run while one is live, and live-looking secrets written into project files, note a command failing the same way three times, and send file reads to the Read and Grep tools.
